notes: Ethereum mainnet, chainId 1. Deploy only HackToken and HackathonMachine; all libraries are internal. Hook flags 0x20cc. Factory deploys and initializes atomically. $owner resolves to the paying wallet for this launch and is permanently excluded as a payout. Request launch economics.poolBps 9000 for the launcher share; its remainder goes to the paying wallet by default (see docs/launch-request.json). The factory performs the supply allocation; the token mints exactly 1000000000000000000000000000 to the factory. Additional 2% IMD hook fees remain as prize funds; the factory's 1% launcher fee is separate. Fees initially become redeemable IMD claims; anyone can redeemFeeClaims and settlement redeems automatically. Specified-IMD partial swaps revert atomically; exact-input sells charge actual filled IMD output. Owner must pin questionHash once using the rendered fixed-window heartbeat, and fund the external weekly oracle schedule. Default split after submitter reward: 70% streamed over 28 days, 10% winner token purchase or stream fallback, 20% carry. No staking, withdrawals or upgrades. See README.md for pool configuration, timelocks, accounting and operational responsibilities. No deployment or broadcast is included.
